verdict.rationale: Bitbucket's own docs describe a built-in Jira UI for managing Jira issues inside Bitbucket, with commit-key status sync and creating Jira tickets from PRs. Older community posts also confirm native issue management, mentioning issue comments and saying they prefer Bitbucket's issue management to GitHub's. Missing for 10: any evidence of labels, assignees, or bug/feature/requirement categorization; first-party docs for a native issue tracker rather than reliance on Jira; recent hands-on corroboration.
